name: Faldir's Cove
summary: Faldir's Cove is a secluded natural harbor nestled along the southern coastline of the Arathi Highlands. Steeped in human history, it is traditionally remembered as the departure point from which early settlers sailed south to found Stormwind. Today, it serves as an emergency shelter for stranded Blackwater Raiders whose fleet ran afoul of local hazards.

sections.title: A Gateway South and a Pirate Haven
sections.body: Tucked away behind the rugged bluffs south of Stromgarde Keep, Faldir's Cove is linked to the mainland by a concealed cave tunnel. The cove honors the memory of Faldir, the ancient Arathor explorer whose expedition set sail from these very shores to cross the Great Sea and establish the southern kingdom of Stormwind. In the present day, however, its quiet waters house a very different crowd: an expedition of Blackwater Raiders from Booty Bay, led by Captains Steelgut and O'Breen, who sailed north pursuing ancient elven treasures only to end up trapped in the bay.

sections.title: The Wreck of the Blackwater Fleet
sections.body: The Blackwater venture turned catastrophic upon reaching the Arathi coast. Strange and unnatural tides conjured by the territorial naga dwelling on the offshore Drowned Reef shattered two of their three vessels. Only the Harbinger survived intact, limping into Faldir's Cove. With the naga prowling the waters and their navigation charts resting beneath the waves, the surviving pirates and their gnomish researchers find themselves marooned, reliant on neutral travelers to battle the aquatic horrors and recover sunken salvage.

faq.answer: Faldir was an ancient pioneer from the early human empire of Arathor. He and his followers embarked from this coastal haven to sail across the seas, journeying south to establish the settlements that eventually became the kingdom of Stormwind.

faq.q: How do you reach Faldir's Cove?
aliases: how to get to faldir's cove
faq.answer: The cove is reached by finding a hidden tunnel passage located just southeast of the outer southern walls of Stromgarde Keep. Walking through this subterranean tunnel brings travelers directly out onto the secluded shore.

faq.q: Why are the Blackwater Raiders here?
faq.answer: Captain Steelgut and Captain O'Breen led an expedition north from Booty Bay in search of sunken elven treasures. Along with gnomish inventors who designed gem-detecting apparatuses, they aimed to salvage precious relics calcified within the offshore reefs.

Two of the expedition's three vessels were destroyed by unnatural tides stirred up by hostile naga inhabiting the Drowned Reef. Only the flagship Harbinger safely made port in the cove, leaving the crew stranded without their sunken charts.

angles.text: Standing upon these shores connects humans to their early heritage, marking the historic launching point where the ancestors of Stormwind parted from the ancient empire of Arathor.
The camp features Doctor Draxlegauge and Professor Phizzlethorpe, who have deployed ingenious engineering contraptions to analyze and extract elven gems from calcified coastal reefs.
